messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — High priority: Customer 'AcmeCorp' reporting quality drop after recent quantization profile rollout on their Dedicated Pool dp-47 (VPC tenant). Error pattern: hallucinations and truncated responses in ~8% of requests. First hits at 2024-10-10T02:14Z. Notifying on-call.

maria (oncall): I'm on it. pulling logs from dp-47 and the tenant routing layer now. Is this limited to generation endpoint or embeddings too?

support-julia: Support thread confirms generation only. Customer provided examples — prompt -> unrelated factual output. They say it started ~40m after our scheduled quantization change.

samir (ml-eng): Likely a precision/quantization mismatch for the customer-specific model variant (acme-prod-v2-quant). We'll check the quant profiles and the exact kernel picks. Most recent deploy ID: qprofile-20241010-03.

elaine (sre): From infra telemetry: dp-47 had a small roll of new kernel selection around the same time. No node reboots. Latency slightly improved but error rate for tenant spiked. Isolation looks intact (no cross-tenant bleed).

devin (solutions): Customer is in a VPC with reserved capacity, they've escalated to their security lead and want a revert ASAP. They prefer no full pool restart.

maria (oncall): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) route AcmeCorp traffic to fallback model (acme-prod-v2-fp16-unquant) on dp-47 if available, 2) otherwise route to dedicated failover in us-west-2, 3) roll back quant profile for acme-prod-v2-quant. Any objections?

samir (ml-eng): +1. Quick check: fallback variant exists but is slightly more costly. Revert steps are safe. Doing local reproduce now with their sample prompts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Route change request submitted: route::acme -> acme-prod-v2-fp16-unquant on dp-47. Status: in_progress.

maria (oncall): ops-bot please monitor tail latency. I'll keep customer updated: "We have a mitigation plan and will revert the quantization profile while keeping your service online." @ae-noah can you notify Acme AE and send a short RCA timeline?

ae-noah: Yep, reaching out to Acme with ETA 30m. Will ask for any extra logs they can share.

samir (ml-eng): Repro attempt: with qprofile-20241010-03 I can reproduce hallucination in ~20% of runs vs ~1% on previous qprofile-20240930. Root cause likely quant bucketing for attention matmul. Preparing rollback patch.

maria (oncall): ops-bot reports route change succeeded, about 90% of traffic now hitting fallback variant. Can anyone confirm customer quality now?

support-julia: Acme reports immediate improvement on sample prompts. They still see occasional truncation but much better. Marking "customer visibly improved".

samir (ml-eng): Rolling back qprofile for only acme-prod-v2-quant to previous version qprofile-20240930. Patch in CI, applying to dedicated config. Command:

```
# revert quant profile for tenant AcmeCorp
redwoodctl dedicated modify --pool dp-47 --tenant acme --model acme-prod-v2 --quant-profile qprofile-20240930
```

Please approve quick deploy (no canary, targeted to tenant only).

elaine (sre): Approving. Ensure we have monitoring alerts on token-level quality evals for the next 2 hours. I'll keep an eye on dp-47 node CPU/GPU utilization.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Patch apply started for acme on dp-47. Tracking ID: dpl-20241010-887.

maria (oncall): Handoff note for next shift (@oncall-next): rollback in progress, routing to fallback until rollback completes. Customer improved but still under monitoring. See dpl-20241010-887. If rollback fails, escalate to full routing to us-west-2 dedicated failover and notify product.

oncall-next: acknowledged, I'll take over in 25m. Please leave any open runbooks and logs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Patch applied successfully. dpl-20241010-887 => success. Rolling metrics for acme-prod-v2 show error rate back down to baseline.

samir (ml-eng): Verified with customer prompts: quality back to expected distribution. Investigating why qprofile-20241010-03 changed kernel heuristics for this model's attention pattern — suspicious interaction with KV cache stats.

maria (oncall): Great. Immediate remediation complete. Next actions: samir to produce short postmortem about quant profile regression and per-tenant safeguards; elaine to run a replay of dp-47 kernel selection under controlled load; support-julia/ae-noah to confirm final customer sign-off and coordinate communication.

support-julia: Acme has accepted the fix and asked for a written summary and compensation request (credits). Sharing request with account team.

samir (ml-eng): Postmortem TODOs: reproduce offline, add validation test for qprofile changes on heavy attention/kv patterns, add canary gating for per-tenant quant profile pushes, and automatic rollback rule if token-level quality drops >3% in 15m for a single tenant.

elaine (sre): Also recommend we add a transient isolation throttle so that a misbehaving quant profile can't spike GPU memory usage for a tenant beyond expected budget.

maria (oncall): Closing loop here: incident state -> mitigated. Will open an incident postmortem ticket and tag owners. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

ae-noah: Sending final customer note and credit proposal. Good job team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) — follow-up task created: PM-INC-20241010-12 for postmortem and action items.

oncall-next: Taking responsibility for monitoring window until 2024-10-10T05:30Z. Ping me if anything regress. :wave:
